assessments.reasoning: Git's Includes section applies the path rule to include.path and the path value of applicable includeIf sections. Its position is relative to the configuration file holding the directive. The independently resolved v2.49.0 release tag points to the same Git commit as this manual.

challenge.method: Read Includes and Conditional includes separately. Contrast a relative path value with the gitdir matching pattern and model the documented anchoring with the containing file at /repo/config/outer.conf, the value child.conf, and the invocation directory at /other.
challenge.results: The path rule selects /repo/config/child.conf. Anchoring against /other does not follow the source. The later gitdir instructions govern the condition pattern and an unsatisfied condition does not insert a file.

limitations: Documentary reasoning for Git 2.49.0. No actual file read, tilde behavior, condition evaluation, other version, or inclusion-depth behavior was tested.
